name: Blocky
description: Story videos with blocky toy characters, cinematic light and word-by-word captions. Vertical, made for short-video stories.

kinds.name: Story
kinds.description: A narrated story, told in quick shots with captions.

fields.label: Your story
fields.placeholder: Last winter, my best friend said my name three times, and the whole town went quiet...
fields.hint: Write it the way a narrator tells it. Every few words become a shot, with captions word by word.

fields.label: Characters
options: Make new characters for this story
fields.hint: The Blocky cast is Milo, Ruby, Grandpa Bo, Mom, Dad and Zee. Keep them so your films feel like one series.

fields.label: Who is the main character?
fields.placeholder: Milo, or: a shy girl with a red cap
